verdict.rationale: API parity is a fair question for a government business-filing service, so the axis applies. The evidence only describes web portal functions (Gateway Portal, OHID sign-in, OH|TAX online filing), and the probes show the SoS hosts returning 403 on robots.txt. Nothing documents a public API, let alone one matching the UI's capabilities.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
